function.name: search_internet
function.label: Searching the web
function.description: Search the Internet for information. Use this tool for recent, current, time-sensitive, or externally verifiable information, including news, recent events, current versions, prices, and information that may have changed. Returns a list of search results containing titles, URLs, snippets, and available metadata. The search engine is selected by the application.

query.description: A precise search query describing the information to find.

function.name: read_webpage
function.label: Reading the page
function.description: Retrieve and extract the readable text of a specific webpage. Use this tool when the content of a particular URL must be inspected in detail, for example to verify information, understand an article, or obtain details not present in search snippets.

url.description: The complete HTTP or HTTPS URL of the webpage to read.

function.name: file_leave_request
function.label: Preparing a leave request
function.description: Prepare a leave request (paid leave, sick leave, remote work, ...) for the user. Use it ONLY when the user clearly asks to take, book or file leave. Fill leave_type, start_date and end_date yourself from what the user said. This tool does NOT file anything: the plan is shown to the user, who must confirm before the request is saved. After calling it, stop: do not claim the request is filed.

leave_type.description: One of: paid_leave, sick_leave, marriage, bereavement, remote_work, unpaid_leave, other.

start_date.description: First day of the leave, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last day of the leave, YYYY-MM-DD. Same as start_date for a single day.

reason.description: Short reason in the user's language. Empty string if none.
